scope: Prospective five previously unused fresh seeds on GH200/aarch64, each in a separate one-GPU Slurm job. Absolute time-to-verified-accuracy under a frozen two-inspection policy. Development seeds 361901/361902 are excluded. Original eta=1/32 instance, data, FP64 equations, Adam/SSBroyden mathematics, numerical tolerances, physical acceptance limits and 4000 active training-second guard are retained. New initialization seeds and an independently derived holdout are registered before any formal initialization. No MN5 continuation, old-job outcome pooling, hardware-time pooling or baseline speedup claim.

instance.note: the original instance of v1-v5; inputs are data/ unchanged

arms.fresh: Fresh deterministic initialization, original Adam4000 then SSBroyden; same optimizer state retained across physical inspections.

training.engine: compiled packed activation with analytic transpose, CUDA Graph replay (as v2 and v5)

optimizer.method: self-scaled Broyden (SSBroyden), dense inverse Hessian in FP64 on the GPU
optimizer.update: Urban, Stefanou and Pons, J. Comput. Phys. 523 (2025) 113656, Eqs. (10), (13)-(23); identical to Kiyani et al., arXiv:2501.16371, Eq. (15) and its definitions; box376.ssbroyden
optimizer.H0: identity (as Kiyani et al.; the update scaling tau adapts it)
optimizer.safeguards: update skipped when y.s <= 1e-12 |y||s|; H reset to I when a direction is not a descent direction or the line search gives no decrease; two consecutive resets end the optimizer phase
optimizer.one_matvec_per_iteration: H y = H g_{k+1} + d_k; H_{k+1} g_{k+1} carried in O(n) and checked against an explicit product at every complete-gradient check

training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: 4000 active training seconds at optimizer boundaries, including training checks/checkpoint IO; synchronous physical observation pauses this clock. No restart or extension.
training.trainer: box376.potential_train_tta; same Adam and SSBroyden mathematics, new-seed qualification and synchronous physical inspections
training.gradient_reference: Fresh full dense parameter AD at initialization and all original periodic checks; separate fixed 131-point native coordinate AD subset with complete parameter gradient per seed

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

physical_observation.note: Synchronous full observation at first completed optimizer boundary >=1000 active seconds after Adam; final observation at <=4000-second guard or natural optimizer stop if no earlier pass. Maximum two observations.

decision_rule.formal_scope: prospective five-new-seed absolute time-to-verified-accuracy under a fixed two-inspection policy; no optimizer baseline speed claim

execution.allocation: one independent Arrhenius job per seed, one GH200, 16 CPUs, 128 GiB host memory, 4 hours maximum
execution.node_count_reason: Each seed is a separately released one-GPU Slurm job. No shared allocation holder.
execution.start_command: Each batch embeds box376.run_c36_tta --packet FROZEN_PACKET --root SEED_ROOT --seed REGISTERED_SEED --deadline-unix SLURM_END_MINUS_900; source/runtime preflight, trainer and synchronous observers, checked full raw archive and immediate batch exit. Independent CPU readback follows release.
execution.failure_archive: outer finite process-group timeout and finalizer preserve negative and partial outputs even if the inner driver fails
execution.protocol_changes: prospective seeds and holdout; fixed two-inspection stopping policy and measured observation-inclusive TTA; original instance, solver math, numerical/physical gates and active training cap retained

amendments.reason: MN5 access retired at user request; exact v5 continuation checkpoints unavailable; GH200 full-gradient compatibility qualified

amendments.reason: User requested new-seed formal time-to-accuracy validation, protocol frozen first and per-seed immediate release.

qualification.native_subset_scope: 131 fixed interior points plus all value families, complete 50692 parameter gradient; not a new full-coordinate-AD objective proof

time_to_accuracy.seed_derivation: SHA256 UTF-8 flashns-c36-formal-tta-20261021-seed-{i}, i=1..5; first four bytes big endian masked with 0x7fffffff
time_to_accuracy.primary_metric: elapsed monotonic seconds from scientific trainer module entry before heavy imports, CUDA context initialization and model/data loading through first complete physical acceptance confirmation; includes preparation, JIT, training, complete checks, checkpoint IO, observer startup and all previous failed observations; excludes queueing, batch module/preflight, archival and later independent readback
secondary_metrics: active training seconds at first passing saved checkpoint (sampled upper bound only)
setup seconds, observer seconds, allocation wall seconds and actual GPU hours
total evaluations, iterations, success count and each failure/censoring reason
time_to_accuracy.sampling_limit: The true first physical crossing between inspections is unknown; do not call a training gate or an unobserved checkpoint physical acceptance. Negative at the terminal observation means not reached by the registered observation policy, not proof of no earlier transient crossing.
time_to_accuracy.success_rule: A seed succeeds only with a complete passing original physical observation plus complete numerical, hash and independent archive audits. Formal cohort qualification requires all five seeds to succeed; always report all 5 denominator entries. No seed replacement or automatic retry.
time_to_accuracy.summary_rule: Report all per-seed outcomes and times. For 5/5 success report median, min/max and Wilson 95% interval for success fraction. Otherwise no success-only cohort median: report empirical completed-event fraction and right-censored/incomplete entries explicitly. No speedup or broad Navier-Stokes claim.
time_to_accuracy.freshness: Seeds and holdout derived once before their first initialization; no optimizer or gate tuning after freeze. Existing development seeds excluded.
time_to_accuracy.infrastructure_failure: Nonzero child, timeout, changed source, missing report, numerical mismatch, or audit failure is INCOMPLETE/INVALID, never a scientific pass and never silently excluded.
time_to_accuracy.observer_memory_policy: During the synchronous inspection, copy the unchanged FP64 dense inverse Hessian to host memory and release its GPU storage. On a negative observation restore the exact tensor to the same GPU before continuing. Keep parameters, iteration, gradients and carried product unchanged; no reinitialization. Spill/restore time is in primary TTA and excluded from active training.
